title: research
short_summary: researches, screenshots, and documents 5 standout non-beige benchmarks across full-length desktop and mobile pages using pure inspiration and live web captures, logging avoid_fonts and avoid_palettes.
when_to_use: use at stage 1 of jason-design-agent to gather 5 standout benchmark markdown dossiers, full-page DevTools screengrabs, and named style range.
summary: Conducts dual-track taste research—yielding 5 standout real-world benchmark examples specifically chosen because they produce 5 visibly different, non-beige structural, chromatic, and material results (supported by inner design research and 19 specialist directories) from a natural-language user prompt before style direction or image generation. Extracts direct layout grids, color polarities, surface physics, and hero UI mechanisms while logging avoid_fonts. Use at Stage 1 of jason-design-agent or when gathering benchmark evidence for designer critiques. Don't use for writing Nano Banana prompts (use image-gen) or building React code (use jason-dev-agent).
